result.topic_en: Geodetic/astronomical reduction of repeated reflection angle measurements with a telescope, computing distances of points A and A' via cotangent formulas and logarithms, followed by a note on combining two complex expressions into the form t cos T + t sin T·i.

methods.what: Mean of repeated reflection angle measurements (repetition method)
Distance of point A from cotangent of measured angle divided by cosine, plus constant
Distance of point A' as half cotangent of angle
Combining sum of complex numbers into polar form: tangent of resulting argument
Modulus of resulting complex number via sine rule
